first_playable.doc: First-playable flow (M2-FP-03; docs/kb/tech/first_playable_flow.md). field_battle: the scene BattleRequest opens and the party a field battle starts with when the request names none (active, reserve, rng seed). prologue: the cutscene the prologue plays and where it hands the party off. end_card: the minimum hold before ui_accept is taken, its fade-in, and the scene accept returns to (the title). haluna: what HalunaStory (game/flow/haluna_story.gd, M2-FP-04) plays in the playable zone: the cutscene on first arrival and its spawn, the field battle's return spawn, victory flag and escape spawn (M2-FP-05: the beach side of the trigger), and the scene the causeway-head trigger opens (Cutscene B on its placeholder set, then the end card). M2-FP-13: after_battle_* is B02 (the in-engine scene played once at that spawn on the first arrival after the tideline battle is won; the scene sets after_battle_flag), before_ending_scene_id is B05 (played at the causeway head before the hand-off), and overheard_hold_sec is how long an overheard bark's line stays up before the next (the B03 fragments, which play as Rhen walks past without stopping him). first_verse: the fight Cutscene B's <<event start_battle>> opens (M2-FP-06): its party (Rhen, Asha and Toma, no reserve), the flag a win sets, and the scene after it (the end card). shell_shrine (M2-FP-16): the trial level the causeway head now opens (haluna.ending_scene), and next_scene, where its exit through the flooded door goes (Cutscene B). party (M2-CMB-07 follow-up; PartyJoins, game/flow/party_joins.gd): who joins Game.state.party_ids, with their starting gear: new_game on Game.new_game(), and joins[flag] when that flag is first set (Cutscene A sets ch02_met_asha: Asha and Toma).
